title: Understanding the organization and its context
summary: Know the internal and external issues relevant to information security, including whether climate change is relevant (Amendment 1).

title: Interested parties
summary: Identify interested parties, their requirements, and which are addressed through the ISMS.

title: Scope of the ISMS
summary: Define ISMS boundaries, interfaces and dependencies.

title: Information security management system
summary: Establish the ISMS and the processes it needs.

title: Leadership and commitment
summary: Top management directs and supports the ISMS and integrates it into business processes.

title: Policy
summary: Set an information security policy with objectives framework and commitments.

title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
summary: Assign and communicate ISMS responsibilities.

title: Information security risk assessment
summary: Define and apply a repeatable risk assessment process: identify, analyze and evaluate risks with owners.
evidence: Risk assessment process and results (documented information).

title: Risk treatment and Statement of Applicability
summary: Choose treatment options and controls, compare with Annex A, produce the Statement of Applicability and treatment plan, and get risk owners' approval.
evidence: Statement of Applicability, risk treatment plan, risk acceptance (documented information).

title: Information security objectives
summary: Set measurable objectives and plan to achieve them.

title: Planning of changes
summary: Plan ISMS changes in a controlled way.

title: Resources, competence and awareness
summary: Provide resources, ensure competence and make everyone aware of the policy and their role.

title: Communication
summary: Decide what, when, with whom and how to communicate about information security.

title: Documented information
summary: Control ISMS documents and records.

title: Operational planning and control
summary: Plan and control the processes needed, including externally provided ones.

title: Risk assessment and treatment in operation
summary: Repeat risk assessments at planned intervals or on significant change, and implement the treatment plan.
evidence: Updated risk assessment results and treatment status (documented information).

title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
summary: Decide what to measure and evaluate ISMS performance and effectiveness.

title: Internal audit
summary: Run an audit program and report results.

title: Management review
summary: Top management reviews the ISMS with all required inputs.

title: Continual improvement
summary: Continually improve the ISMS.

title: Nonconformity and corrective action
summary: React, find causes, act and verify effectiveness.

title: Policies, roles, segregation, management duties
summary: Information security policy set, roles assigned, conflicting duties separated, managers enforce rules.

title: Authorities, special interest groups, threat intelligence, projects
summary: Keep contacts with authorities and groups, collect threat intelligence, and build security into projects.
evidence: Contact list, threat intelligence records, project security checks.

title: Assets, classification, labeling and information transfer
summary: Inventory assets, classify and label information, and protect it in transfer.
evidence: Asset inventory, classification scheme, transfer agreements.

title: Access control and identity
summary: Control access by business need, manage identities, authentication and access rights.
evidence: Access requests, periodic access reviews, joiner/mover/leaver records.

title: Suppliers and cloud services
summary: Manage security in supplier relationships, contracts, the ICT supply chain and cloud services.
evidence: Supplier assessments, contract clauses, monitoring records.

title: Incident management
summary: Plan, assess, respond to and learn from incidents; collect evidence.
evidence: Incident reports, lessons learned, exercise records.

title: Continuity and ICT readiness
summary: Maintain security during disruption and ensure ICT readiness for continuity.

title: Legal, IP, records, privacy, independent review, compliance, procedures
summary: Meet legal and contractual requirements, protect records and personal data, review security independently, document operating procedures.
evidence: Legal register, privacy records, independent review results, operating procedures.

title: People controls
summary: Screening, terms of employment, awareness, discipline, leaving, confidentiality agreements, remote working and event reporting.
evidence: Screening records, signed terms and NDAs, training records, leaver checklists.

title: Physical controls
summary: Secure perimeters, entry, offices, equipment, clear desk and screen, storage media and secure disposal.

title: Endpoints, privileged access, access restriction, authentication
summary: Protect user devices, restrict privileged rights and source code, and use secure authentication.
evidence: Device inventory, privileged access reviews, MFA configuration.

title: Malware, vulnerabilities, configuration
summary: Protect against malware, manage technical vulnerabilities and secure configurations.
evidence: Patch records, vulnerability scans, configuration baselines.

title: Deletion, masking, data leakage, backup, redundancy
summary: Delete data when no longer needed, mask where required, prevent leakage, back up and provide redundancy.
evidence: Deletion records, backup and restore test results.

title: Logging, monitoring and clock synchronization
summary: Produce and protect logs, monitor for anomalies and synchronize clocks.
evidence: Log configuration, monitoring alerts and reviews.

title: Network security and cryptography
summary: Secure and segregate networks, filter web access and use cryptography properly.
evidence: Network diagrams, firewall rules review, key management records.

title: Secure development, testing and change
summary: Secure development life cycle, testing, outsourced development, environment separation and change management.
evidence: Secure coding standards, test results, change records.
